title: cynoglossum tetraspis
intro: Cynoglossum tetraspis, commonly known as Chinese forget-me-not, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum tetraspis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and insomnia.
